selection_reason: Completed 1.5B student/JustRL teacher, batch64 n1 DP8; cover full-data direct, full-data discounted, and one-shot direct. Exclude val-only, top-K training and other student sizes.
stage_comparison_window: global steps 2-12; local H800 graph uses steps 2-5
gpu_statistics: Sample means; old W&B GPU stream ~15-second cadence; conservative rollout/validation interiors trim 15 seconds at each end plus unallocated stage residual. Short teacher/actor stages are not resolved.
timer_caution: One-Shot opd_teacher is nested inside adv and includes its scoring path, not isolated model forward. Do not add both timers.
